mayaCharts: Beautiful, accessible charts in five lines. Zero dependencies. The browser is the chart engine.
Uses modern platform: Custom Elements, Web Animations API, CSS Anchor Positioning + Popover, CSS custom properties.

USAGE:
HTML: <maya-chart><script type="application/json">{spec}</script></maya-chart>
JavaScript: chart.spec = {type: "bar", data, x: "month", y: "revenue"}; chart.data = newRows;
SSR: import {render, renderShell} from "mayacharts"; render(spec, {width, height});
Global: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mayacharts/dist/maya.global.js"></script> (everything). Lighter: maya.core.global.js (element, the 13 core types, maya.host), then one maya.<module>.global.js per module type the spec needs, e.g. maya.hierarchy.global.js.
Hosts: maya.host.thoughtspot(viz, spec) and maya.host.columns({schema, data}, spec) (ESM: import {thoughtspot, columns} from "mayacharts/host") build rows from a columnar result, match fields given as a RegExp or a case-insensitive name against the columns, unwrap {value()} cells, find or create #chart, and return the element. thoughtspot calls viz.events.emitRenderCompletedEvent() once the chart settles (also after an error).
Core types (13, in maya.core.global.js and every ESM build): bar line area scatter heatmap waterfall kpi dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel table list.
Module types, ESM import then classic script (load it after maya.core.global.js; maya.global.js has all of them):
  import "mayacharts/hierarchy" / maya.hierarchy.global.js: treemap sunburst marimekko waffle
  import "mayacharts/flow" / maya.flow.global.js: sankey chord
  import "mayacharts/radial" / maya.radial.global.js: radial gauge
  import "mayacharts/geo" / maya.geo.global.js: hexmap (50 US states, DC, PR)
  import "mayacharts/stats" / maya.stats.global.js: boxplot funnel
  import "mayacharts/weave" / maya.weave.global.js: weave
  import "mayacharts/units" / maya.units.global.js: units
  import "mayacharts/orbit" / maya.orbit.global.js: orbit
  import "mayacharts/constellation" / maya.constellation.global.js: constellation
Other entry points: "mayacharts" (render, renderShell, renderParts, validateSpec, MayaSpecError, registerTheme, version, types), "mayacharts/element" (registers <maya-chart>), "mayacharts/host", "mayacharts/themes" (18 ready-made theme token sets; importing it registers them by name; maya.global.js ships them as maya.themes), "mayacharts/theme.css" (the stylesheet), "mayacharts/schema.json", "mayacharts/global" (maya.global.js). Each release publishes an SRI hash for every dist/*.global.js; pin the version in the CDN URL.

SPEC FIELDS (an option set to null is unset, except type and data):
type: enum = required. bar line area scatter heatmap waterfall kpi dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel table list treemap sunburst sankey chord marimekko waffle radial gauge hexmap boxplot funnel weave units orbit constellation
data: Row[] = required. Row objects with field values.
y: field | field[] = required. Value field; array adds measure toggle (funnel without x: one stage per field; kpi: one tile per field, shown together, or one at a time with toggle; gauge: one field, or an array with toggle; no x, no series).
toggle: boolean = false. With a y array, one measure at a time behind the measure control (view.measure): a kpi draws one tile instead of one per field; a gauge takes a y array only with it. With it, aggregate, was, yDomain and colorBy may be keyed by y field. kpi gauge. Example: {type: "kpi", x: "month", y: ["sales", "units"], toggle: true, yDomain: {sales: [0, 26e6]}, colorBy: {sales: {target: 24.8e6}}}
x: field = "". Category field (scatter: numeric x; hexmap: state; boxplot: one box each; funnel: the stage, omitted when y lists the stages; list: the headline, or path[0]).
xType: auto|category|time = auto. How x is spaced. "auto": time axis when every x is ISO 8601 date on line, area or vertical bar without sort/limit; else categories. "time" accepts epoch ms. Example: xType: "category"
aggregate: sum|mean|count|min|max|{ratio: [field, field]}|{[y field]: either} = sum. How rows sharing (category, series) combine. Not boxplot (it summarises raw rows). {ratio: [numerator, denominator]} sums both fields per group and divides, so a ratio measure (price = sales / units, margin, conversion) is right in every category, drill level, Other bucket and "mean" rule; a zero denominator gives null. y then only names the measure (titles, format) and need not be in the rows; other fields (y2, tooltip fields, a colorBy field) sum. Ratio: bar line area heatmap dumbbell table kpi gauge hexmap; not with stack or was (part-to-whole types need sizes that add up). With a y array that toggles the measure, key it by y field; the active measure uses its rule and unlisted fields sum (not parallel table funnel constellation, which show every measure at once, nor kpi without toggle). Example: y: "price", aggregate: {ratio: ["sales", "units"]}, or y: ["gap", "price"], aggregate: {price: {ratio: ["sales", "units"]}}
sort: asc|desc|change = data order. Order categories by total across all series; "change" (dumbbell only) by to minus from, largest gain first. bar line area heatmap dumbbell table radial waffle orbit.
limit: positive integer = -. Keep top N categories; rest roll up into "Other". A bar with more categories than fit (past 10000 marks) does this on its own when limit is unset, and says so in warnings. bar line area heatmap dumbbell table radial waffle orbit.
series: field = null. Split into series (heatmap: row category; boxplot: boxes side by side; weave: one thread each, required; constellation: colours the stars by group). bar line area scatter heatmap dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel marimekko radial boxplot weave constellation.
path: field[] = none. Hierarchy outer to inner. treemap sunburst sankey chord (chord: 2 or 3 levels, a third splits the target arcs while the sources stay); bar line area dumbbell table radial waffle hexmap waterfall marimekko with drill (replaces x; a drilled hexmap state draws its children as horizontal bars, largest first; marimekko without series: the next level is the series, so path [region, family, itemType] stacks regions by family, then West's families by item type); heatmap with drill (replaces series, the rows); list: [headline, evidence]. Example: path: ["region", "state"]
seriesPath: field[] = none. Series hierarchy, outer to inner: the series is the current level; with drill the gesture on a mark splits its series into the next level (view.drill holds series values; breadcrumb, Back, Escape pop). Not with path or series (drill the categories with path, or the series with seriesPath). bar line area. Example: {type: "area", x: "quarter", y: "sales", seriesPath: ["family", "item"], stack: true, drill: true}
xPath: field[] = none. Column hierarchy, outer to inner: replaces x; with drill a column header click (or Enter on it) drills the columns on their own (view.xDrill), beside path on the rows. heatmap only. Example: {type: "heatmap", path: ["region", "state"], xPath: ["family", "itemType"], y: "sales", drill: true, totals: true}
depth: positive integer = 1 with drill, every level without. Levels drawn at once below the current branch, each parent holding its children under a name strip; a click drills into the parent under the pointer. treemap only. Example: depth: 2
minAngle: whole degrees 0..360 = slices under 4 px across fold. Sunburst slices narrower than this fold into one grey "Other (n)" slice per ring (the largest sibling never folds; how many fold by default depends on the chart size). 0 folds nothing. sunburst only. Example: minAngle: 2
size: field = null. Bubble, dot or star area (sqrt scale). scatter beeswarm constellation.
name: field = null. Point identity and tooltip title (units: one dot per row). scatter beeswarm boxplot units.
body: field = null. Text under each list headline (two lines at most on small tiles). list only.
rowFormat: field = null. Field holding each list row's own format, a preset or a template ("currency", "{value} pts"); invalid-format names the row. list only.
totals: string[]|true = []. x values drawn as running-total bars; a total before any step opens at its own y (a bridge from last year's figure). waterfall. heatmap: totals: true adds a Total row and column (text.total), combined by aggregate over the rows of visible series. waterfall heatmap.
start: string = none. x value of the opening total: drawn first wherever its row is, at its own y (last year's figure), not a running sum. With path and drill a drilled step opens at the running total before it (text.before, "Before West") and closes at the total after it (text.after). waterfall only. Example: {type: "waterfall", path: ["region", "state"], y: "change", drill: true, start: "2025 YTD", totals: ["2026 YTD"]}
stack: boolean|"percent"|"stream"|(boolean|"percent"|"stream")[] = false. Stack series instead of grouping. bar area only. An array of 2 or more distinct modes adds a Layout control (text.stacks; options text.unstacked for false, stacked, percent, stream) that switches between them, first one shown; view.stack indexes it ([] is unset). Example: stack: [true, "percent"]. "stream" (area only): a streamgraph, the stack centred on a wiggle baseline; values must be 0 or more; the value axis and grid are off by default (yAxis, grid bring them back); the tooltip shows each value. "percent": each category's visible values as shares of its total (axis 0 to 100%, hidden series renormalise; negatives are shares of the summed magnitudes, below 0). Labels, tooltips and the table show the share, not the raw value. y is formatted "percent" unless format sets it. Numeric rules are shares (0.5 = 50%); "mean" is the mean share of the drawn segments. A radial always stacks: stack: false on it is option-unsupported. Example: stack: "percent"
horizontal: boolean = false. Categories on left axis. bar dumbbell.
y2: field = null. Second value field drawn as line on right axis (vertical bar). orbit: growth, which sets each planet's speed and direction. bar orbit.
was: field|{by: field, current?, previous?} = null. Previous value: a dashed ghost bar at the old value over each bar (the value axis spans the ghosts), keyed in the legend by the was title, "was {value}" in the tooltip (text.was), a data table column, and a description sentence naming the 2 largest relative moves (text.since: "Since Last week: North +12%, West -10%."). kpi: a second comparison (e.g. same period last year); gauge: a marker at the old value; heatmap: a "was" tooltip row and table column per cell (field and {by} forms). Long data (one row per item and period): was: {by: "Year"}; the latest distinct by value is current, the one before it previous (ISO dates and epoch ms sort as time, else data order), other periods are dropped, rows sharing (x, period) combine by aggregate, and the ghosts are titled by the previous period formatted by format[by] (titles[by] overrides). current/previous pick periods, matched as strings. With a y array, key it by y field ({sales: "salesLY", units: "unitsLY"}): the ghosts follow the measure toggle (kpi tiles: one each), unlisted measures have none; an object with a string by is the long form. With series (bar): one ghost per grouped bar. bar kpi gauge heatmap; not with stack; by is not x. Example: was: "lastWeek" or was: {by: "year"} or was: {sales: "salesLY"}
compare: ("previous"|"was"|"target")[] = all three. Which change lines a kpi prints under the headline, in this order: previous (against the previous category), was (spec.was), target (colorBy target; the bullet and status stay). [] prints none. kpi only. Example: compare: ["was"]
numberMotion: "count"|"roll" = count. How a kpi headline moves to a new number on first draw and on every change (element only; off under reduced motion): count counts up, roll rolls each digit column like an odometer. kpi only. Example: numberMotion: "roll"
back: spec without data = none. A second face for a kpi: a chart spec of any type but kpi over the kpi's rows (frame applied). A Details button (text.flip, aria-pressed) turns the card over; view.face is "front" or "back" and renderShell renders either; Escape returns. Its errors name spec.back.<path>. kpi only. Example: back: {type: "bar", x: "month", y: "sales", horizontal: true, sort: "desc", limit: 3}
arc: 180|270|360 = 180. Sweep of the gauge dial in degrees; 360 is a closed ring. gauge only. Example: arc: 360
form: "bars"|"line" = bars. Radial form: "line" is a radar, one closed line per series (angle = x, radius = y from zero); dash draws series dashed (an open line where a series has gaps); hover on a spoke lists every series; the legend isolates. radial only. Example: form: "line"
zero: boolean = true. Value axis includes zero; false fits it to the values, recomputed at each drill level, for small changes between large values. dumbbell only. Example: zero: false
emphasis: string[] = []. Series values drawn with a heavier stroke (theme lineEmphasis), with their legend swatch. Needs series; each value must be a series value; [] is the same as unset. line only. Example: emphasis: ["2026"]
colorScale: linear|rank|quantile|log = linear. How values map to the colour ramp: rank gives even steps by order (skewed totals), quantile five equal-count classes (the legend shows the breaks), log needs values above 0. heatmap hexmap. Example: colorScale: "rank"
tint: boolean = false. Children take evenly spaced tints of their parent's colour instead of their own slots: the levels of a path below a drilled value (treemap sunburst sankey chord waffle), and weave threads under a group colorBy (needs colorBy). A colors map then names path values or groups. Example: tint: true
brush: boolean = false. Drag a range on an axis to keep the lines inside it; ranges on several axes combine with AND and the rest dim; a click on the axis clears it. State in view.brush ([field, lo, hi] per axis), reported by maya-view. parallel only. Example: brush: true
forms: ("waffle"|"bars"|"swarm")[] = all three. Forms a units chart switches between, first shown (view.form picks another); with 2 or more a form control appears. units only. Example: forms: ["waffle", "swarm"]
frame: field = null. Playback: one frame per distinct value (data order, matched as strings, null skipped, at most 200 or too-many-marks). Renders one frame, the last by default (view.frame picks another); the title becomes "{title}, {frame value}" (text.frameOf, value formatted by format[frame]); value axes span every frame so they hold still. The element adds a Play button. kpi: a scope (YTD or All) shown one at a time. bar line area scatter dumbbell kpi. Example: frame: "year"
format: preset|template|{[field]: preset|template|Intl} = auto. Per field or one string for all measures. Template: "{value:percent} gross". Intl options also take prefix and suffix text. Example: format: {margin: "{value:percent} gross", gap: {maximumFractionDigits: 1, signDisplay: "exceptZero", suffix: " pts"}, price: {style: "currency", currency: "USD", prefix: "~"}}
titles: {[field]: string} = {}. Display names everywhere (axis, tooltip, legend, table).
labels: boolean = null. Formatted value on marks. heatmap: true at ≥24 px. treemap and sunburst: names, marimekko: shares, on unless false.
text: {[key]: string} = {}. Localised UI strings with {0} placeholders; TEXT KEYS below says what each controls. Keys: noData other blank back reset showing drilledInto drillInto zoomedTo selected selectionCleared chartOf chartOfAll firstOf measures crumbs positive negative above below near onTrack atRisk offTrack vs change pts target sortedBy ascending descending offBelow offAbove total shareOf fromTo reduced points point range density perCell mean perX rule log play pause frameOf frame was since forms waffle bars swarm perDot count rank speedBy gross alike nearest max q3 median q1 min rows ofPrevious ofFirst first last labelled peerMean brushed brushCleared flip stacks unstacked stacked percent stream filter showMore crumbsX before after.
locale: BCP47 = en-US. Formatting locale.
currency: ISO4217 = USD. Currency for "currency" preset.
title: string = "". Visible heading and accessible name. Data tokens fill in from the chart: {max.x} {max.y} {min.x} {min.y} {first.x} {first.y} {last.x} {last.y} {total} {mean} (y of the active measure, formatted by format). Without a selector max, min, first and last read one drawn point (stacked: the category totals) and total sums every series. A series selector reads one series only: {max.y:2025} {last.y:2025} {first.x:2025} {total:2025} {mean:2025}; an unknown series value stays as written. Scatter: max and min by y, first and last by x, .x the x value (or name when set). With no rows a title holding a token is dropped (the empty state shows alone). Only these exact names are replaced; any other brace text stays as written. In an element under 200 px tall the title is one line with an ellipsis. Example: title: "{max.x} leads with {max.y}"
subtitle: string = "". Second line under the title, smaller and muted; takes the same data tokens. Hidden in an element under 200 px tall. Not in the bare render() SVG (renderShell and the element show it).
description: string = "". Accessible description; auto-generated when omitted.
yDomain: [min, max] = null. Fixed value-axis domain; [hi, lo] reverses it (ranks with 1 on top). kpi: the bullet scale; gauge: the dial range. An off-step end gets its own tick unless its label would touch its neighbour. Not with a y array, except keyed by y field on kpi and gauge: yDomain: {sales: [0, 26e6]} (unlisted measures take the default).
xDomain: [min, max] = null. Fixed x domain. scatter only.
rules: (number|"mean"|{y, label?}|{y2, label?}|{x, label?}|{band: [lo, hi], label?}|{slope, intercept?, label?})[] = []. Reference lines, at most 4; label at most 40 characters. Numbers and "mean" run across the value axis; "mean" is the average of the visible values (stacked: of the category totals; stack "percent": of the segment shares; ratio aggregate: total numerator / total denominator); unlabelled it reads "Average". The line shows its formatted value after the label. Numbers widen the value axis; outside a yDomain they are not drawn. {x} draws a rule across the category axis at that category (time axis: that date; scatter: that x); an x matching nothing draws nothing. {band: [lo, hi]} shades a value range. {y2} (bar with y2 only) runs across the right axis, labelled by format[y2], and widens it. Beeswarm "mean" is the mean of the visible rows. Scatter only: {slope: k, intercept: b} draws y = k * x + b (intercept default 0); slope "mean" is sum(y) / sum(x); its label shows the slope as y per x by format[y] and the x title (text.perX: "Average price $38 per unit") and sits along the line where it covers the fewest points; set text.perX to "{0} per unit" for a singular unit. A rule label takes the first free spot along its line inside the plot, after value labels and annotations, else it is dropped (the description still names it). [] is the same as unset. bar line area scatter dumbbell beeswarm. Example: rules: [{y2: 0.8, label: "80%"}, {y: 100, label: "Target"}, {x: "2025-06", label: "Launch"}, {band: [80, 100], label: "Target range"}]
yScale: "log" = linear. Log value axis, ticks at powers of 10 (and 2, 5 when sparse). Every plotted value must be above 0 (non-positive-value). line scatter beeswarm; a bar encodes its value as length from zero, so bar, waterfall and area refuse it. Example: yScale: "log"
xScale: "log" = linear. Log x axis; every x must be above 0. scatter only.
annotate: ("max"|"min"|"first"|"last"|{x, text})[] = []. Label those points of each visible series with their formatted value (scatter: max and min by y, first and last by x); {x, text} labels the mark at that x with the text (at most 40 characters). Labels collide like value labels and annotations win; the plot keeps a label row of headroom so a point at the top keeps its label. [] is the same as unset. bar line area scatter. Example: annotate: ["max", "last", {x: "CA", text: "Largest store"}]
dash: string[] = []. Series values drawn dashed (line, the area outline, a radar line, their legend swatch and end label). Needs series; each value must be a series value; [] is the same as unset. line area radial (form "line"). Example: dash: ["2024"]
tooltip: boolean|{fields: (field|{field, ratio: [num, den]})[]} = true. Hover/keyboard tooltip. {fields} adds those fields as rows (and data table columns), formatted by format; bar, line, area, heatmap and dumbbell combine them by aggregate (numeric only), scatter and beeswarm show the row's value. {field, ratio: [num, den]} shows sum(num) / sum(den) wherever rows combine, named field (titles and format key it; it need not be in the rows). A field already shown appears once. fields: bar line area scatter heatmap dumbbell beeswarm gauge (combined over every row). Example: tooltip: {fields: ["units", {field: "price", ratio: ["sales", "units"]}]}
legend: boolean|"top"|"bottom"|"right" = true if series, waffle, hexmap, units (toggles groups). Legend; clicking toggles series. A position places it (true is "top"). Line and area: dropped when direct end labels show, unless set explicitly.
endLabels: boolean = true. line area. Name each series at its right end with its last value (2 to 8 visible series, no value labels, no y2; below 400 px the label is the value alone and the legend names the series). false brings back the legend.
drill: boolean = false. Click/Enter zooms into branch of path; breadcrumb, Back, Escape pop. With select too: click/Enter selects, double-click/Shift+Enter (or the pinned tooltip's "Drill into" button) drills. At the last level the drill gesture fires maya-drill-leaf {path}. Sankey: drill starts from the first column, then continues one column at a time through any non-final node (the drilled node stays as the first column). treemap sunburst sankey chord; bar line area dumbbell table heatmap radial waffle hexmap waterfall marimekko with path; bar line area with seriesPath (the gesture splits the mark's series; svg data-drill="series"); heatmap with xPath (a column header drills the columns, view.xDrill, a second breadcrumb with aria-label text.crumbsX; at the last column level maya-drill-leaf has axis: "x").
drillOut: boolean = true. With drill, a click on empty chart space goes back up one level.
expand: spec without data|"first"|"none"|"all" = none (list: "first"). table: a sub-chart under a row, over that row's rows (rows whose x equals it); without x or path it takes the table's x; a click or Enter opens it, one row at a time (view.expanded); with select too the gestures split as with drill. The sub-chart takes no drill, zoom, frame, expand, drillTo, back, page, scroll or filter; errors name spec.expand.<path>. list: which moves start open. table list. Example: expand: {type: "bar", x: "month", y: "sales", was: "lastYear"}
drillTo: spec without data = none. line with series: the drill gesture on a series (view.drill = [series value]) replaces the line with this sub-chart over that series' rows, under a breadcrumb; Back and Escape return. Without x it takes the line's x. was: "previous" compares with the series before it (first-appearance order) at the same x, its ghosts titled by that series. Errors name spec.drillTo.<path>. line only. Example: {type: "line", x: "month", y: "cumulative", series: "year", drillTo: {type: "bar", y: "monthly", was: "previous"}}
page: positive integer = none. table: rows shown at first; a "Show n more" row (text.showMore) adds n (view.page counts the pages added); the table grows and scrolls inside the tile. table only. Example: page: 25
scroll: boolean = false. table: every row (at most 1000) drawn, scrolling inside the tile with the header held at the top. table only.
filter: boolean = false. table: a search box (input type search, aria-label and placeholder text.filter) keeping rows whose x or columns value contains the text, ignoring case (view.filter). table only.
columns: field[] = []. table: text fields as their own columns after the row label (each row's first value), sortable and matched by filter. table only. Example: columns: ["itemType"]
cells: {[title]: {type: "strip", field, by, last?, tone?: "sign"}} = {}. table: extra columns; a strip draws one square per distinct by value (data order, the last `last`) holding field combined by aggregate, toned by sign (theme up and down). Rows stay flat: one row per (x, by). table only. Example: cells: {Form: {type: "strip", field: "change", by: "month", last: 5}}
bars: {[y field]: "bar"|"diverging"|"none"}|boolean = "bar" per column (list: false). table: the bar in each measure cell; diverging grows left or right from the cell centre (theme up and down). list: true draws each move's evidence as bars on a scale local to that move. table list. Example: bars: {vsType: "diverging", units: "none"}
select: true|"multi"|{peers: field} = off. Click/Enter/legend selects marks; Escape clears. With drill: double-click/Shift+Enter drills. {peers: field} (beeswarm): a selected mark also lights every mark sharing its value of that field, with their average (text.peerMean); view.peers holds that value. kpi: the sparkline points. list: a move. bar line area waterfall scatter heatmap kpi dumbbell ridgeline beeswarm parallel table list marimekko waffle radial treemap sunburst hexmap boxplot funnel weave units orbit constellation.
zoom: boolean = false. Drag to zoom. line area scatter. Reset, double-click, Escape restore.
animate: boolean = true. Animate the first draw and every update (element only; off under reduced motion).
colors: string[]|{[name]: color} = null. An array holds at most 8 distinct colours; a map takes any number of names (past 8 series they share slots). Precedence: a map key beats colorBy tones, which beat theme series1..8, which beat the array, which beats theme.accent; a value ramp (colorBy field, heatmap, hexmap) ignores the map. A map is keyed by series value; treemap and sunburst by path[0] value; sankey and chord by node name (links and inner levels inherit); waffle by category; weave with a group colorBy, and tint with path, by group or path value. Unmatched keys are ignored. A sankey root missing from the map takes theme neutral at every drill level. Path types give every name a slot from all rows, so colours hold through drill; a host filter that drops names can move array slots, a map never moves. Example: colors: {Outerwear: "#d1543a"}
colorBy: "sign"|{target?: n, warn?: n, better?: "higher"|"lower"}|{[y field]: {target?, warn?, better?}}|field = null. Tone by sign (theme up and down) or target, or ramp by numeric field. Not with series; weave takes a group field instead (one colour per group from colors, up to 20 threads, tint for shades within a group). Target: at or past it is good, better "lower" flips it; types other than kpi and gauge need target and take no warn. kpi and gauge: any of target, warn, better; warn needs target and sits on the bad side (higher: warn < target; lower: warn > target); tones good, warn ("at risk"), bad, status words onTrack/atRisk/offTrack. kpi with a y array, and gauge with toggle: also keyed by y field. Example: colorBy: {target: 100, warn: 80}. bar line area waterfall scatter dumbbell kpi gauge treemap sunburst hexmap units orbit constellation weave.
theme: {[token]: css}|name|[name, {[token]: css}] = {}. Theme tokens (CSS values, allowlisted), a registered theme's name, or a name plus overrides. Tokens: font fontSize fg fgMuted grid bg accent radius tooltipBg tooltipFg focus good warn bad line (line width) gridDash (grid dash array) titleSize titleWeight axisSize (axis text) subtitleSize labelSize (value labels and annotations) legendSize heroSize heroWeight (the kpi and gauge number) emptySize (the no-data text) numeric ("tabular" or "proportional" figures) rampLow rampHigh rampMid (the value ramp of heatmap, hexmap and calendars; rampMid makes it diverging) rampMidValue (a number, the value at rampMid, default 0) up down total (direction colours: waterfall steps and totals, colorBy "sign", dumbbell connectors, diverging table bars; default good, bad, fgMuted, except waterfall steps, which keep series1 and series2 until up or down is set) neutral (Other, unmapped names, folded slices) cellGap cellRadius (heatmap and waffle cells, px) labelInk labelInkOnFill (label colours on light and dark fills) lineEmphasis (stroke width of emphasis series) ghost (was ghosts) series1 series2 series3 series4 series5 series6 series7 series8 (palette slots). Names: import "mayacharts/themes" (or maya.global.js, which has them as maya.themes) registers the 18 ready-made sets, and registerTheme(name, tokens) (maya.registerTheme) adds a house theme once for every chart. An unknown name is invalid-theme listing the registered ones. Example: theme: ["slate", {accent: "#6A7891"}]
grid: boolean = true. Grid lines perpendicular to value axis.
xAxis: boolean = true. Bottom axis.
yAxis: boolean = true. Left axis.
table: boolean = true. Visually hidden data table for screen readers.
$schema: string = "". Ignored; for editors and LLMs.

TEXT KEYS (spec.text, default in quotes):
noData = "No data". Empty-state text in the plot when no row holds a number; "\n" breaks a line, long text wraps.
other = "Other". Category name of the spec.limit roll-up, and the sunburst fold "Other (n)".
blank = "(blank)". Category label for a row whose x (or path level) is null or missing.
back = "Back". Root breadcrumb button, and the live region after drilling back to the top.
reset = "Reset zoom". Button that resets a zoom window.
showing = "Showing {0}". Live region after a measure toggle: {0} = measure title.
drilledInto = "Drilled into {0}". Live region after drill: {0} = branch path joined with " / ".
drillInto = "Drill into {0}". Pinned tooltip action when drill and select are both on: {0} = the mark's name.
zoomedTo = "Zoomed to {0} – {1}". Live region after zoom: {0}, {1} = first and last category (or range ends).
selected = "{0} selected". Live region after selection: {0} = count.
selectionCleared = "Selection cleared". Live region after the selection is cleared.
chartOf = "{0} chart of {1} by {2}". Auto description: {0} = noun, {1} = y title, {2} = x title.
chartOfAll = "{0} chart of {1}". Auto description without a category field: {0} = noun, {1} = y title.
firstOf = "First {0} of {1} rows". Table caption when rows are capped: {0} = shown, {1} = total.
measures = "Measure". aria-label of the measure radiogroup.
crumbs = "Drill path". aria-label of the breadcrumb nav.
positive = "Positive". Tone word of a positive value with colorBy "sign" (tooltip, table, tone legend; not kpi).
negative = "Negative". Tone word of a negative value with colorBy "sign" (not kpi).
above = "above target". Tone word of a value on the good side of colorBy.target (tooltip, table, tone legend; the bad side when lower is better; not kpi, whose tile and tooltip say onTrack).
below = "below target". Tone word of a value on the bad side of colorBy.target (the good side when lower is better; not kpi).
near = "at risk". Tone word for the warn band, colorBy { target, warn } (tooltip, table, tone legend; not kpi, whose tile and tooltip say atRisk).
onTrack = "On track". kpi and gauge status word for the good tone (the kpi tooltip too).
atRisk = "At risk". kpi and gauge status word for the warn tone (the kpi tooltip too).
offTrack = "Off track". kpi and gauge status word for the bad tone (the kpi tooltip too).
vs = "{0} vs {1}". kpi delta: {0} = signed change, {1} = previous period.
change = "{0} {1} ({2}) vs {3}". kpi comparison: {0} = arrow, {1} = absolute change, {2} = percent change, {3} = what it is compared with.
pts = "{0} pts". kpi and gauge change on a percent measure: {0} = signed difference in points.
target = "target". kpi and gauge label of colorBy.target (the {3} of change, the gauge's target label) and the description's target.
sortedBy = "Sorted by {0}, {1}". Live region after a table header click: {0} = column title, {1} = ascending/descending.
ascending = "ascending". The {1} of sortedBy for an ascending sort.
descending = "descending". The {1} of sortedBy for a descending sort.
offBelow = "off track below {0}". Chart description of a warn threshold when higher is better: {0} = the warn value.
offAbove = "off track above {0}". Chart description of a warn threshold when lower is better: {0} = the warn value.
total = "Total". Sunburst centre at the root; the heatmap totals: true row and column.
shareOf = "{0} of {1}". Sunburst tooltip share: {0} = percent, {1} = parent name.
fromTo = "from {0} to {1}". Auto description on a time axis: {0} = first date, {1} = last date.
reduced = "Showing {0} of {1} points". Description when a time axis was downsampled: {0} = points drawn, {1} = points in the data.
points = "{0} points". Scatter density cell tooltip (too many points to draw): {0} = point count.
point = "{0} point". One scatter density cell holding a single point: {0} = 1.
range = "{0} to {1}". A span of values: {0} = from, {1} = to.
density = "Shown as {0} density cells, {1} to {2} points each". Description of a density scatter: {0} = cells drawn, {1} = fewest points in a cell, {2} = most.
perCell = "Points per cell". Title of the density colour legend.
mean = "Average". Label of an unlabelled rules: ["mean"] line.
perX = "{0} per {1}". Scatter slope rule value after its label: {0} = slope formatted by format[y], {1} = x title.
rule = "Reference line". Description name of an unlabelled numeric rule ("Reference line: 100.").
log = "{0} on a log scale". Description with spec.xScale or spec.yScale "log": {0} = the axis title.
play = "Play". Frame playback button (spec.frame).
pause = "Pause". Frame playback button while playing.
frameOf = "{0}, {1}". Title with spec.frame: {0} = title, {1} = formatted frame value.
frame = "Frame {0} of {1}". Auto description with spec.frame: {0} = frame number, {1} = frame count.
was = "was {0}". Tooltip line of a bar with spec.was: {0} = previous value.
since = "Since {0}: {1}". Description with spec.was: {0} = was title, {1} = the 2 largest moves ("North +12%, West -10%").
forms = "Form". aria-label of the units form radiogroup.
waffle = "Waffle". Units form option: waffle.
bars = "Bars". Units form option: bars.
swarm = "Swarm". Units form option: swarm.
perDot = "Each dot is one {0}". Units description: {0} = the name (or x) title.
count = "Count". Units data table: header of the rows-per-group column.
rank = "Rank {0}". Weave tooltip and description: {0} = rank (1 is the highest value).
speedBy = "Orbit speed shows {0}". Orbit description: {0} = y2 title.
gross = "Gross {0}". Orbit sun title when a value is negative (the total is the sum of magnitudes): {0} = y title.
alike = "Closer points are more alike across {0}". Constellation description: {0} = measure titles joined with ", ".
nearest = "Closest: {0}". Constellation tooltip: {0} = the nearest names joined with ", ".
max = "Max". Boxplot maximum label (tooltip, table); annotate "max" in the description.
q3 = "Upper quartile". Boxplot upper quartile label.
median = "Median". Boxplot median label.
q1 = "Lower quartile". Boxplot lower quartile label.
min = "Min". Boxplot minimum label (tooltip, table); annotate "min" in the description.
rows = "Rows". Boxplot row count label.
ofPrevious = "% of previous". Funnel tooltip and table label: conversion from the previous step.
ofFirst = "% of first". Funnel tooltip and table label: conversion from the first step.
first = "First". Annotate "first" in the description.
last = "Last". Annotate "last" in the description.
labelled = "Labelled points: {0}". Description of annotate: {0} = the kinds joined with ", ".
peerMean = "{0} average". Beeswarm select { peers }: label of the peers' average line, {0} = the peers' value.
brushed = "{0} of {1} shown". Live region after a parallel brush: {0} = lines kept, {1} = all lines.
brushCleared = "Filter cleared". Live region after the parallel brush is cleared.
flip = "Details". kpi with spec.back: the button that turns the card over (aria-pressed says which face shows).
stacks = "Layout". aria-label of the stack mode radiogroup (spec.stack as an array).
unstacked = "Separate". Stack mode option for false: grouped bars, overlaid areas.
stacked = "Stacked". Stack mode option for true.
percent = "Percent". Stack mode option for "percent".
stream = "Stream". Stack mode option for "stream".
filter = "Filter". aria-label and placeholder of the table search box (spec.filter).
showMore = "Show {0} more". Table row that shows the next page (spec.page): {0} = rows it adds.
crumbsX = "Column drill path". aria-label of the heatmap column breadcrumb (spec.xPath with drill).
before = "Before {0}". Drilled waterfall opening total: {0} = the drilled value.
after = "After {0}". Drilled waterfall closing total: {0} = the drilled value.

ERROR CODES:
spec-not-object: spec must be a plain object
missing-field: type/data/x (or path)/y is required but missing
unknown-type: chart type not recognized (with module hint if needed: the ESM import and the maya.<module>.global.js file)
data-not-array: data must be an array of row objects
row-not-object: data[i] must be a plain object
unknown-field: field-valued option names no field in data
non-numeric-y: y field value not a finite number (null allowed)
non-numeric-field: size/scatter x/colorBy field value not a finite number
non-positive-value: treemap/sunburst/sankey/chord y value must be positive; funnel and ridgeline y value must not be negative; a value on a log axis (yScale/xScale "log") must be above 0
unknown-option: top-level spec key not recognized
invalid-option: option value wrong type or invalid value
option-unsupported: option not valid for this chart type or incompatible with another option
stack-unsupported: stack (true or "percent") not allowed with type "line" (use "area" instead)
invalid-domain: xDomain not [min, max] with min < max; yDomain not two different numbers (reversed allowed); bounds within 1e300, span at least 1e-300
invalid-format: format preset unknown, bad Intl options, or unsupported locale/currency
invalid-theme: theme token or theme name not recognized (the message lists the registered names)
unsafe-css-value: colors/theme CSS value blocked by allowlist (no url(), other functions, ; { } < > \)
invalid-size: RenderOptions width/height not a finite number > 0
unknown-state: hexmap x value is not a US state (two-letter code or full name; 50 states, DC, PR)
too-many-marks: more than 10000 marks (the message gives the count, the cap and the row count; suggest limit or aggregate). Bars roll up, categorical lines and kpi thin, scatter bins and tables draw the rows that fit instead of failing.
invalid-date: xType "time" with an x value that is neither an ISO 8601 date nor epoch ms
too-few-measures: constellation y is not an array of at least 2 measures

EVENTS AND STATE:
Events (bubbles: true, composed: true):
  maya-select {selected: Sel[], target: (Sel & {value}) | null}
  maya-view {measure, drill, window, hidden, form, stack, face, sortBy, brush, peers, xDrill, expanded, page, filter} (user actions only; xDrill = heatmap column branch; expanded = the open table row or list move (raw x, "" = none); page = table pages added; filter = table search text; stack = index into a stack array; face = "front" or "back" for a kpi with back; window = zoom slice; sortBy = table header click sort; brush = parallel ranges [field, lo, hi][]; peers = the selected beeswarm mark's peers value)
  maya-drill-leaf {path, axis?} (the drill gesture on a mark at the last level: path holds one raw value per path level, root first. Hosts drill through here, e.g. open the rows behind CA > Jackets. A heatmap column at its last xPath level fires it with axis: "x" and the xPath values. Sankey and chord fire it once drilled to their last branch)
  maya-error {code, path, message} (cancelable with preventDefault())
  maya-render {} (after each paint; entrance and update animations may still run)
  maya-settled {error} (after the last animation of that paint, in the same task when nothing animates; also after maya-error, with the error). Hosts that snapshot (PDF export, screenshots, render-complete hooks) wait for this, or set animate: false.
Promise: await el.settled (the current or next paint; resolves when settled, rejects with the MayaSpecError on maya-error).
Two-way sync properties:
  el.view: {measure?, drill?, window?, hidden?, sortBy?, frame?, form?, stack?, face?, brush?, peers?, xDrill?, expanded?, page?, filter?} - getter/setter (no events on set; {} resets; sortBy = [field, "asc"|"desc"]; frame = index into the distinct frame values, default the last, larger clamps; form = index into units forms, default 0, larger clamps; stack = index into a stack array, default 0; face = "front" (default) or "back")
  el.selected: Sel[] - getter/setter (no events on set)

ELEMENT <maya-chart>:
Source of the spec, first set wins: el.spec property (el.data = rows sets it too), then a <script type="application/json"> child, then the spec attribute (the only observed attribute). el.spec = undefined falls back to the child or attribute. Property sets in one task render once (microtask); a resize renders on the next frame.
Properties: spec, data, view, selected, settled (read-only promise). Static: MayaChart.version. Method: el.toSVG() returns a standalone SVG string with the CSS custom properties resolved (dark mode exports correctly). No other public methods.
Gestures: hover or touch shows the tooltip; click or Enter on a mark drills (drill) else selects (select); with both, click or Enter selects and double-click or Shift+Enter drills (a click selection commits about 250 ms later unless a double-click turns it into a drill; the pinned tooltip has a "Drill into" button, not shown at the deepest level). Space pins the tooltip. Arrow keys move between categories and series; Home and End jump on the measure toggle. Escape pops, in order: pinned tooltip, brush, selection, zoom window, one drill level. Table header Enter or Space sorts. With zoom: drag a brush, + or = halves the window, - doubles it, double-click or Escape resets. A legend click toggles a series.
Shadow DOM: parts you can style from outside are the --maya-* custom properties only (set them on maya-chart or an ancestor). Inside, stable hooks for tests and hosts: .maya-title .maya-sub .maya-ctl .maya-legend .maya-crumbs .maya-reset .maya-box .maya-svg .maya-sr .maya-tip .maya-err .maya-play .maya-flip; marks carry data-maya="mark", data-key, data-c, data-s, data-tone.
Custom properties: --maya-<token> for each theme token in kebab case (fgMuted is --maya-fg-muted, series3 is --maya-series-3), plus --maya-ease for transitions. Height: the chart fills its container's height; with no definite height it keeps a floor; under about 160 px it draws a compact frame. Colour scheme follows color-scheme on the page or on the element.
SSR: renderShell(spec, {width, height, view, selected, nonce}) returns <maya-chart> with a Declarative Shadow DOM and a JSON child holding only the fields the chart uses, so it works without JS and hydrates when the element loads. render(spec, opts) returns a bare SVG (no legend, title or controls). renderParts(spec, opts) returns the pieces. Pure: no window or document, safe in Node, workers and edge runtimes.
Security: every string is escaped; spec CSS values pass an allowlist (unsafe-css-value otherwise); no inline style attributes; no network requests. Trusted Types: create the policy before the element loads, trustedTypes.createPolicy("mayacharts", {createHTML: s => s}), and use CSP trusted-types mayacharts. Pass nonce to renderShell for a strict style-src.
Known ceilings (caps and approximations, each with its reason): https://github.com/BbekShr/mayacharts/blob/main/NON-FEATURES.md. Notable: at most 10000 marks (bars roll up, other types reduce or throw too-many-marks), 8 colours, 4 rules, 12 tooltip rows, units 1500 dots, UTC dates.

RULES FOR AGENTS:
1. Never put functions in spec: the spec is JSON, serializable, diffable, and hashable. No callbacks, formatters, or data transforms.
2. Unknown types need imports: if a module type ("treemap", "sankey", "hexmap", "boxplot", "funnel", "weave", "units", "orbit", "constellation"...) fails with unknown-type, add the import the error names, e.g. import "mayacharts/weave", or without a bundler the script maya.weave.global.js after maya.core.global.js.
3. Read errors.html when MayaSpecError thrown: every error links https://bbekshr.github.io/mayacharts/errors.html#<code> with cause and fixed example.
4. Values are plain JSON. Pick the type from the question: compare categories bar, trend line or area, relationship scatter, composition treemap or waffle, flow sankey, status kpi or gauge, distribution boxplot or beeswarm, recommendations with evidence list. Map fields as x = category, y = value, series = split, whatever the orientation.
5. Check the option table above for the chart type before adding an option: an option on a type that does not accept it throws option-unsupported. Do not invent keys; unknown-option names the closest valid one.
6. For a ratio measure (average price, margin, conversion) use aggregate {ratio: [num, den]}, never a per-row ratio that gets summed or averaged.
7. For a host that needs to know the chart is finished (screenshots, PDF, render-complete hooks) wait on maya-settled or await el.settled; for ThoughtSpot or any columnar result use maya.host.thoughtspot or maya.host.columns instead of hand-built rows.
8. For drill-through into rows use drill with maya-drill-leaf; for cross-filtering use select with maya-select; add both on one chart and the gestures split (click selects, double-click or Shift+Enter drills).
